description: Laravel package (egyjs/dbml-to-laravel) that generates Eloquent models and migrations from DBML / dbdiagram.io schema files, and incrementally syncs DBML changes into new create/alter/drop migrations with `php artisan dbml:sync`.
rules: Install with `composer require egyjs/dbml-to-laravel --dev`; Node.js 18+ must be on PATH (the DBML parser is pre-bundled, no npm install needed).
Treat the DBML file (usually `database/schema.dbml`) as the single source of truth; do not hand-write migrations for tables it manages.
First run: `php artisan dbml:generate database/schema.dbml`. After every DBML edit: `php artisan dbml:sync database/schema.dbml --force`.
Always pass `--force` in non-interactive shells so commands never wait on a confirmation prompt.
Never remove `// @dbml-sync:*` / `// @enddbml-sync:*` markers in generated models; put custom model code outside them.
Commit the `.dbml-sync.json` snapshot that is written next to the DBML file; `dbml:sync` needs it.
Declare each DBML relationship once (inline `[ref: > table.id]` or a top-level `Ref:`), never both.
Only `>` / `<` refs generate foreign keys and belongsTo/hasMany; one-to-one (`-`) and many-to-many (`<>`) refs are ignored.
